title: Pre-Export Row Scaling for Generated Mixed-Integer Programs: Mechanism Attribution and Residual-Budget Contracts

creators.name: Rodríguez Castro, Mathias
creators.affiliation: Facultad de Ingeniería, Universidad de la República, Montevideo, Uruguay

description: Local metadata prepared for a future research artifact release. This revision studies identifiability of post-normalization block summaries and conditional residual-budget row scaling. It contains mathematical analysis, exact dyadic factor selection, independently verified binary stress data, a matrix export audit and reconstructed dispatch evidence. No submission, acceptance, or upload of this revision is claimed. Source code: MIT; data and aggregate results: CC BY 4.0; manuscript rights are separate.
